material: Unfilled PETG; PLA for first fit only
orientation: Grooves left/right on the board; clip arcs front/back. Keep within +/-10 degrees (or 180 degree equivalent), particularly at SW16 beside the heatsink.
installation: Remove the main keycap. The Choc V2 switch may remain fitted if actual stem/stack matches the tested envelope. Not for the six small option-button apertures.
qualification: Prototype snap fit. Acrylic and print tolerances are acceptance targets, not JLCPCB PCB tolerances. No insertion/removal force or fatigue guarantee.
